hop._source: Bluetooth Core 6.3 [Vol 2] Part G §2: Connection state hop sequences, CLK start 0x0000010, 32 rows x 16 slots

access._source: Bluetooth Core 6.3 [Vol 2] Part G §3: LAP | preamble | sync word | trailer (transmission order, hex nibbles)

legacy._source: [Vol 2] Part G §10.1–§10.5 (E1, E21, E22, E3). Bytes: index 0 leftmost

ssp._source: [Vol 2] Part G §7.1 (ECDH) and §7.2 (f1, g, f2, f3, h3, h4, h5). Big-endian hex
